about: Per-page budgets for tools/release/perf.js, measured as a mid-range phone on slow 4G (see the script). kb = bytes over the wire without narration or video, requests = network requests, both for the whole visit without a tap (to the moment the network goes quiet, since 2026-11-13: before that the count stopped 3 seconds after the load event); fcp, lcp, tbt in ms. Raise one only with a reason in the PR that Sam approves; lower them when a page gets lighter.
